question: Which Indian para-athlete was honoured with the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award in 2025 for his achievements in high jump?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Praveen Kumar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Praveen Kumar** is an Indian para-athlete who specializes in the **high jump** category in para-athletics.
 
• He was awarded the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award in 2025**, the highest sporting honour in India, for his exceptional achievements in the high jump event.
 
• Praveen Kumar gained significant recognition for his outstanding performance in the **2021 Tokyo Paralympics**, where he won a **silver medal** in the **high jump T64 event** with a record-breaking jump of **2.07 meters**.
 
• His achievement not only brought pride to India but also highlighted the dedication and determination of para-athletes in the country.
 
• The **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award** is given to sportspersons who have demonstrated exceptional performance in their respective fields over the past four years and contributed significantly to Indian sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award:**

 
 
• The award is the **highest sporting honour** in India, named after the legendary hockey player **Major Dhyan Chand**, known as the "Wizard of Hockey."
 
• It was instituted in **1991-1992** and is awarded annually by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
• It is given to sportspersons who have shown outstanding performance at the international level over a period of four years.
 
• The award includes a medal, a certificate, and a cash prize of **₹25 lakh**.
 
 
 
• **Achievements of Praveen Kumar:**
 
 
• Praveen Kumar competes in the **men's T64 category**, which is for athletes with a leg amputation who compete with prosthetics in a standing position.
 
• He made history with his **silver medal win at the 2021 Tokyo Paralympics**, achieving a personal best and Asian record jump of **2.07 meters**.
 
• His success has inspired many aspiring para-athletes in India to pursue sports and aim for excellence at the international level.
 
 
 
• **Other Indian Para-Athletes in High Jump:**
 
 
• **Mariyappan Thangavelu:** Gold medalist in the **2016 Rio Paralympics** in the T42 high jump category. He is also a recipient of the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award (2020).
 
• **Sharad Kumar:** Bronze medalist in the **2021 Tokyo Paralympics** in the T63 high jump category. He has been an inspiration for many para-athletes.
 
• **Varun Singh Bhati:** Bronze medalist in the **2016 Rio Paralympics** in the T42 high jump category, showcasing India's prowess in para-athletics.
 
 
 
• **About the Paralympics:**
 
 
• The **Paralympics** are a major international multi-sport event involving athletes with a range of disabilities.
 
• The **Summer Paralympics** are held every four years, following the Olympic Games, and feature a variety of sports adapted for athletes with disabilities.
 
• India has been an active participant in the Paralympics, with numerous athletes achieving remarkable success and bringing laurels to the nation.
 
 
 
• **Important Points:**
 
 
• The recognition of para-athletes with awards like the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna reflects India's commitment to promoting inclusivity in sports.
 
• Such achievements encourage more individuals with disabilities to participate in sports, fostering a culture of equality and excellence.
 
• India has been progressively improving its performance in the Paralympics, showcasing the talent and determination of its para-athletes on the global stage.
